167: // setupDmverity ensures a dm-verity device exists and is verified for the given
168: // source, returning the device path to mount and, when this call created the
169: // device, its name so the caller can clean it up on a later error.
170: func setupDmverity(ctx context.Context, source string, metadata *dmverity.DmverityMetadata) (devicePath, createdDevice string, _ error) {
171: 	log.G(ctx).WithField("source", source).Debug("detected dm-verity metadata, setting up dm-verity device")
172: 
173: 	supported, err := dmverity.IsSupported()
174: 	if err != nil || !supported {
175: 		return "", "", fmt.Errorf("layer requires dm-verity but system doesn't support it (dm_verity module not loaded): %w", err)
176: 	}
177: 
178: 	// Extract snapshot ID from source path
179: 	// Path format: {root}/snapshots/{id}/layer.erofs
180: 	snapshotID := filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(source))
181: 	deviceName := fmt.Sprintf("containerd-erofs-%s", snapshotID)
182: 	devicePath = dmverity.DevicePath(deviceName)
183: 
184: 	// Try to create dm-verity device first (avoids TOCTOU race)
185: 	log.G(ctx).WithFields(log.Fields{
186: 		"source":      source,
187: 		"device-name": deviceName,
188: 		"hash-offset": metadata.HashOffset,
189: 	}).Debug("opening dm-verity device")
190: 
191: 	if _, err := dmverity.Open(source, deviceName, source, metadata.RootHash, metadata.HashOffset, nil); err != nil {
192: 		// If Open failed because the device already exists, reuse it after verification.
193: 		if _, statErr := os.Stat(devicePath); statErr != nil {
194: 			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open dm-verity device: %w", err)
195: 		}
196: 		if verifyErr := dmverity.VerifyDevice(deviceName, metadata.RootHash); verifyErr != nil {
197: 			return "", "", fmt.Errorf("existing dm-verity device %q verification failed: %w", deviceName, verifyErr)
198: 		}
199: 		log.G(ctx).WithField("device", devicePath).Debug("dm-verity device already exists and verified, reusing")
200: 		return devicePath, "", nil
